svg.text: Hover a frame for details. Click to zoom, double-click the background to reset, Ctrl+F to search.
select u.name AS name,agg.total_spent AS total_spent
select testdb.orders.user_id AS user_id,sum(testdb.orders.total) AS total_spent
Width = time for that operation (wider = slower). Bottom = query root; top = leaf table access.
Click a frame to zoom in on that operation. Ctrl+F to search. Hover for time, rows and loops.
Warnings below refer to specific operations by label (e.g. TABLE SCAN [users]).

materialization=on — A subquery or derived table is executed once and its result stored in a temporary table for reuse. It may spill to disk past tmp_table_size (MySQL's TempTable engine) or the smaller of tmp_table_size and max_heap_table_size (MEMORY engine, MariaDB).
1 temp table(s) (Materialize) — up to 3000 rows; may spill to disk
1 sort operation(s) — 10 rows; may use disk-based filesort

• Check internal_tmp_mem_storage_engine and temporary-table disk usage before raising tmp_table_size. Why: the default TempTable engine limits each in-memory internal temporary table by tmp_table_size, and max_heap_table_size does not apply to it; only the MEMORY engine also
uses max_heap_table_size, taking the smaller of the two. A temporary table in the plan does not by itself show that it spilled to disk.
• Increase sort_buffer_size or add an ordered index to avoid filesort
